introduction.text: A small research codebase trains recurrent neural networks to imitate simulated guitar-amplifier nonlinearities and exports the learned model to framework-free C inference.

good_for.text: Exploring the sound-versus-compute tradeoff for a future embedded guitar effect or responsive sound object.

demo.text: Scripts generate local A/B WAVs; no hosted listening demo or completed hardware performance was verified.

installation.text: Follow the documented route for the intended platform; commands below are reference instructions, not tested in this review.
steps: Clone the GitLab source into an isolated Python environment. The reviewed repository root contains no requirements.txt or pyproject.toml; dependencies require manual review.

requirements.platforms: No tested macOS, Windows or Linux matrix is documented. Deployment to a real microcontroller/audio codec remains on the roadmap.
